EmailTemplate.subject: How are credit card fees impacting your travel experiences?
EmailTemplate.textOnly: [Blog] Understanding the Hidden Cost Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, ‌ As demand for international travel surges, travelers want to pay by credit card. Nearly 80% of the travelers we recently surveyed – all of which had taken at least one international trip in the last year – said a credit card was their preferred method when paying for trips. ‌ The details of the additional fees you’ll incur by enabling card payments aren’t always entirely clear to your business – and they’re definitely not always clear to your clients. Without clarity, it can be hard to identify areas in which to save. There’s a solution to this problem. ‌ Read this blog to learn: - Why it is important to pay attention to credit card fees - Fees travel providers can expect with domestic vs. international payments - And ways to reduce credit card fees for international travel payments READ THE BLOG Are you interested in learning how your payment process stacks up to your peers?
